description: Parses every JSON-LD block on a page and reports the schema.org types found, blocks that fail to parse, and whether the types a shopping agent looks for are present. Point it at a product page to check Product and Offer markup, or at a homepage to check Organization and WebSite.

url.description: The exact page URL to inspect. Use a product URL to check Product markup.

name: check_structured_data
title: Check a page's structured data
